review_notes: I read the whole file. I also grepped the project for the underlying definitions (`operator`, `operatorPath`, `fieldLift`, `translated`). `liftedOperator`, `liftedOperatorPath`, `liftedOperatorPathLinear`, `liftedOperatorPathMap` and `constructedEvolution` are thin specialisations of the project's own Lp multiplier and evolution machinery (`EulerLpSupportedMultiplier.operator`, `operatorPath`, `liftEvolution`). They are not independent reimplementations of a Mathlib concept. I know of no Mathlib counterpart for a multiplication operator on a supported-subspace L² with operator-valued coefficients. The `local instance` declarations only cache `inferInstance` results for the instances Mathlib already has. They do not create competing structures. I did not check the project's own multiplier or evolution files for overlap with each other. I found no justified duplication of a Mathlib concept.
